findings.matureShadeRoot: Four low herbaceous black-olive rosettes with attached pale edible root shoulders; complete silhouettes.
findings.spentShadeRoot: Four chewed brown rootstocks; no broad leaves or intact pale edible bulb.
findings.matureAshberry: Four asymmetric thin-stemmed low shrubs with recognisable attached red berry clusters.
findings.spentAshberry: Four matching low branch crowns with no leaves or red berries.
findings.pairRegistration: Eight pairs share one scale and a basal ground anchor. Crowns correspond approximately; source geometry is not pixel-identical.
findings.cropSafety: No visible cut-off tips or foliage from neighbours in the 16 proposed regions; no fixed soil/water/farming rows.
findings.native16: Mature berries preserve visible red dots; mature leaf masses and bare spent silhouettes differ. Fine detail collapses at16px as expected.
findings.contrastLimitation: The dark ShadeRoot mature leaf mass has low contrast against the selected mottled forest dirt. Actual map lighting/zoom/adjacency review remains required before release; source review does not establish field readability.
